alyssa: Alert — p99.9 tail latency for hosted/text-gen spiked from ~180ms to ~1.3s starting 21:37 UTC, sustained for ~12m. Error budget alarm fired. :frowning:
ben: saw this on infra dashboard, do we have a recent rollout? :eyes:
deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-18T21:35:42Z by @carlo — scheduler:cohort-weighting v2.1.3 promoted to canary (20% traffic).
carlo: that rollout included the cohort-weighted admission change (PR #4187) — it shifts admission tokens toward "interactive" cohorts and reduces fair share for background cohorts. rolling canary at 20% started at 21:35.
maya: KV cache metrics from the affected GPU pods: eviction_rate spiked x6 around 21:36, avg kv_cache_hit dropped 92% -> 64%. microbatch_size distribution shifted right (median 4 -> 9).
ben: kernel-selector logs around 21:36 show increased kernel fallback frequency, e.g. `kernel_pick: fused_fast -> fallback_generic (latency 220ms->980ms)` repeated across shards.
alyssa: so cohort weighting caused larger microbatches for some requests which pushed KV cache thrash -> more cache misses -> larger seq lengths -> kernel selector mispredictions -> fallback -> tail. Does that chain make sense?
carlo: yup. the new weighting increases admission tokens for cohort-id that tends to accumulate prefixes, so continuous batching batches longer prefixes together. kvcache evictions are the immediate signal.
ben: quick check — can we temporarily pin canary to 0% or roll back that config only?
carlo: I can flip the canary flag. quick mitigation: set scheduler.cohohort_admission.max_weight=0.15 and admission.burst_limit=8 to cap microbatch growth.
alyssa: paste the command to flip canary and the temp config please.
carlo: `rdctl rollout set canary scheduler:cohort-weighting=0% --env=canary` and `kubectl -n runtime exec -it sched-controller -- /bin/sh -c "rdctl config set scheduler.cohohort_admission.max_weight 0.15 && rdctl config set scheduler.admission.burst_limit 8"`
ben: applied patch and set canary->0% at 21:43. also pushed a telemetry patch to emit microbatch size histogram per-cohort (PR #4202).
ops-runbook-bot: Runbook entry: "cohort-weighting-induced-kvcache-thrash" — mitigation steps: 1) throttle cohort weight, 2) limit burst_size, 3) revert canary, 4) monitor kv_cache_hit and kernel_fallback_rate for 15m.
maya: post-mitigation stats: eviction_rate back to normal within 3m, kv_cache_hit recovered to 88%, microbatch median down to 3. p99.9 trending ~210ms now.
alyssa: great. follow-ups: (1) carlo to open revert + smaller incremental rollout plan with canary telemetry, (2) eng-runtime to add automated alert for kernel_fallback_rate delta, (3) add kvcache per-cohort telemetry and eviction heatmap. assigning owners: carlo, ben, maya.
ben: noted. I'll also add a guard in the admission controller to refuse weight changes that increase expected median microbatch size > factor 1.5 without canary telemetry.
alyssa: thanks all. keeping this thread for post-mortem notes. :thumbsup:
